preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 100,000.
The number of ants m must be between 1 and 10,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: All edges must connect valid vertices within the range of 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and 1 <= c <= n and 1 <= d <= n for a, b, c, d in ant_pairs)
preconditions.description: All favorite pairs for each ant must consist of valid vertices within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.description: If the output is 'NO', it indicates impossibility; otherwise, it must start with 'YES' followed by m lines indicating the chosen pairs.

postconditions.expression: all(choice in {1, 2} for choice in stdout.splitlines()[1:])
postconditions.description: Each line after 'YES' must indicate either 1 or 2, representing the chosen pair for each ant.
